blocks.text: Universal quantifier batata hai ke statement kisi set ki tamam cheezon ke liye sach hai (Figure 2.8 dekhein). Is ka nishaan “∀” hai (ulta A). Maslan “∀x, x > 0” ka matlab hai “har x ke liye, x zero se bara hai.” Universal quantifier kisi domain (group) ki har cheez ke baare mein aam statement banata hai. Maths aur logic ke proofs (saboot) mein yeh aham hai. “For all” kehne ka matlab hai ke set ki koi bhi cheez is statement ko nahi torti. Yeh quantifier qaide aur aam sachaiyan saaf bayan karta hai.

items: ∀ (ulta A, All): statement set ki har cheez ke liye sach.
“∀x, x > 0”: har x zero se bara hai.
